cues.text: You dare to turn your back on me?
ENOUGH! Bring forth Crondis and Apmeken
Tumeken's heart. Delivered to me by these mortals
your light will be snuffed out, once and for all
I WILL NOT BE SUBJUGATED BY A MORTAL!
Your companions will betray you, as they always do.
You will take their place, and watch as this vision becomes reality
Crondis. It should have never come to this.
